title: Unit normalization of the pullback composition mate
statement: Fix unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. For schemes X,Y,Z [def-pc-scheme] and morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, let p(f,g):Lg* followed by Lf* ≅ L(fg)* be the fixed comparison of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and a(t) the pinned adjunction of [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction, def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. For every homotopy complex K of O_X-modules, the right-derived unit for (fg)_* followed by the component at QK of conjugateEquiv(a(fg),a(g).comp(a(f)),p(f,g).hom) equals the unit for g_* at f_*K followed by Rg_* of the unit for f_* at K. The right-derived units are those of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No square, direct-image composition comparison, flatness, boundedness or preservation of K-injectives is assumed.

source.place: Tags 079W (lemma-adjoint), 0D5S (lemma-derived-pullback-composition) and 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); single-pair normalization step of lem-sc-derived-direct-image-square-mate. The cited tag pages were read online.

proof.text: Let ε be the left-derived counits selected with p. The factorization equation for p says that Q(p.hom) followed by ε(fg) equals the successive ε(g) and ε(f), followed by the homotopy image of the underived tensor-pullback composition comparison.

The Hom equivalence normalization of the pinned a(t) identifies the mate, across localization, of ε(t) with the recorded right-derived unit β(t). Indeed evaluate the normalization at the underived counit; the underived adjunct of that counit is the identity. Paste the two resulting mate squares for g and f. Mathlib mateEquiv_hcomp identifies their mate with the pasted β(g) and Rg*(β(f)).

The underived tensor comparison is defined as the inverse conjugate of pushforwardComp. On homotopy categories its conjugate is the corresponding direct-image composition identification: pass to complex representatives and check degreewise units, counits and the underived conjugacy equation. The identification is the identity on sections over inverse-image opens, so its homotopy and localized components are identities.

Transpose the factorization of the first step using the preceding compatible mate squares. mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_vcomp and conjugateEquiv_mateEquiv_vcomp identify the two sides with β(fg) followed by the derived mate of p.hom, and the pasted right-derived units, respectively. Evaluating this equality at K gives the claimed equation. The mate calculation uses no resolution or cancellation hypothesis; it applies to identity morphisms, zero complexes and empty schemes. To justify using the pinned Hom normalization on arbitrary derived test maps, choose a K-flat representative of their source and replace the intermediate complex of a localization roof by a K-flat resolution. Invertibility of the left-derived counits on these representatives (and their successive pullbacks), naturality, and inversion of localized quasi-isomorphisms extend the computation to all roofs. Yoneda then gives the component equation. The earlier assertion that no resolution is used referred only to the formal mate-pasting calculation, not to this extension of the representative formula.

proof_origin.note: Detailed mate-pasting expansion of the normalization step already in the parent proof, from the cited Stacks adjunction and composition results; not claimed as a verbatim statement of Stacks.

theorem derivedPullbackComposition_mate_unit
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    let p : ∀ {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (s : A ⟶ B) (t : B ⟶ C),
        derivedPullback t ⋙ derivedPullback s ≅ derivedPullback (s ≫ t) :=
      @Classical.choose _ _ (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})))
    (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
        (conjugateEquiv (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} (f ≫ g))
          ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} g).comp (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} f))
          (p f g).hom).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).map
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K)
